Do NOT use for firewall rules — use firewall-aiops. Managed cloud load balancers are out of scope. Governed proxy operations with a built-in governance harness (audit, policy, token budget, undo, risk-tiers). Behaviour is validated by a mock-based test suite; see docs/VERIFICATION.md for the live-verification checklist.
